test_ppo_agents: test PPOAgent with blind, rgb, depth, or rgbd input types at 256 or 384 resolution
test_simple_agents: test ForwardOnlyAgent, GoalFollower, RandomAgent, and RandomForwardAgent against a Habitat benchmark
run_test_ppo_agents: run pytest on test_ppo_agents to evaluate PPOAgent across multiple sensor input types and resolutions
run_test_simple_agents: run pytest on test_simple_agents to evaluate simple baseline agents over 100 episodes each
review_test_baseline_agents: review the test_baseline_agents module to understand how PPOAgent and simple agents are benchmarked in Habitat
